name: Fisch
creator: Fisching
redeem: Launch Fisch on Roblox and wait for your character to load in.
Click the Menu button at the top of the screen.
Choose the Codes section from the list on the left side of the menu.
Type the code into the text box exactly as shown, capital letters included, and press Enter.
notes:
Fisch is a fishing adventure from the Fisching group. You hold to cast your bobber, shake your rod to get a bite sooner, then keep a white bar on top of the fish in a reeling minigame. Each fish can roll a mutation or an odd size, so there are hundreds of thousands of versions to collect. Selling fish earns C$, the game's money, which buys better rods, bait and boats to reach new islands and deep sea areas.

Fisch codes usually give C$, rod skins, bobbers, bait, totems and boat or submarine parts. C$ and totems help new players the most, since they speed up rod upgrades and rare fish hunts. A new code almost always comes with each weekly update and lasts about a week before it stops working, so check back after every update.

codes.reward: Submarine parts: a back fin, a submarine top, a metal panel, a side fin and a window

faq.q: Why does my Fisch code say it expired when it came out last week?
faq.a: Most Fisch update codes only last about a week. VroomVroom, the code from the racing update, already stopped working on September 27, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a certain level to use Fisch codes?
faq.a: Many update codes need level 25. SCARLET, TemporarySubmarine and CARBON have no level lock, so brand new players can use them right away.

faq.q: What are the TemporarySubmarine parts for?
faq.a: The code gives five pieces used to build a submarine: a back fin, a submarine top, a metal panel, a side fin and a window. Keep them in your inventory until you are ready to build.

tips: Do not worry about slipping during the reeling minigame. The game says it is okay to mess up a few times, so stay calm and follow the fish.
Your rod matters most early on. Better rods make reeling easier and give you better odds at rare fish, so upgrade it before buying extras.
Use bait when you fish. Different baits can help you get bites faster or improve your chances at better catches.
Some fish only appear in certain places or conditions, so try different spots instead of fishing in one place all day.
useRewards: None of the current codes give C$. SCARLET is a skin for Nate's Blade and CARBON is a bobber, both only change how your gear looks. TemporarySubmarine gives five submarine parts, so keep them in your inventory until you are ready to build. Since most update codes need level 25, fish toward that level so you can redeem the next update code.
